description: Business object for the approver action panel — holds approver context, editable comment/decision, and action buttons

properties.name: approverName
properties.description: Display name of the current approver

properties.name: totalLayers
properties.description: Total number of approval layers in the route

properties.name: contextMessage
properties.description: Optional context message displayed above the comment area

properties.name: comment
properties.description: Approver comment / review note (writable by user)

properties.name: decision
properties.description: Current decision value set by the approver (writable); e.g. 'approve', 'reject', 'return'

properties.name: actions
properties.description: List of action buttons available to the approver

nestedTypes.description: A single action button in the approver action panel

properties.name: actionKey
properties.description: Unique key identifying the action (used in actionClicked event)
